command:
(
    set -eu
    test "$(uname -r)" = 5.10.160-rt89-g9f9e9d18574d-dirty
    test -z "$(losetup -a)"
    test "$(cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk0p12/size)" = 786432
    grep -qx PARTNAME=cache /sys/class/block/mmcblk0p12/uevent
    test -z "$(ls -A /mnt/cache)"
    attached=0
    cleanup_copy() {
        if [ "$attached" = 1 ]; then
            umount /mnt/cache || return 1
            attached=0
        fi
    }
    trap cleanup_copy EXIT
    mount -t ext4 -o ro,noload /dev/mmcblk0p12 /mnt/cache
    attached=1
    test ! -e /tmp/rootfs-check.sh
    test ! -e /tmp/linux-rootfs-check.sh
    cp /mnt/cache/rtctrl-network-rootfs-20261004/rootfs-check.sh /tmp/rootfs-check.sh
    cp /mnt/cache/rtctrl-network-rootfs-20261004/linux-rootfs-check.sh /tmp/linux-rootfs-check.sh
    printf '%s  %s\n' c9e7a6981bad88108f1a3b52566c02dee2d90689cf844ff6eae9dbb60e2784e4 /tmp/rootfs-check.sh | sha256sum -c -
    printf '%s  %s\n' 6152f5666bbd87d9d597a5409107a06c15c548ed401de36babbdec07febe633b /tmp/linux-rootfs-check.sh | sha256sum -c -
    cleanup_copy
    trap - EXIT
    sh /tmp/linux-rootfs-check.sh a67752f777c7c25b8f7aca570dfada72c68b1ef39c295f6bd8ccd207e11523fc
)
